fr.text:
FINAL RULES
1. Desk monitor / iPad = signed in as the salon. Never signs out.
2. Switch person: pop-up → Lock → faces → face + PIN.
3. Auto-lock after 2 min idle. Last person outlined = 1 tap back.
4. Every PIN use logged (who, when, device, what, OK / wrong). 5 wrong → wait 1 min + owner text.
5. Discount / refund / void = manager PIN pop-up.
6. Tech at iPad/kiosk = clock in/out + own pay sheet (tickets, then totals). Nothing else.
7. Settings = owner or manager PIN only. Team + Add member live there.
8. Own phone / computer = phone code once, stays signed in; pop-up shows only that role’s items.
9. Only the owner can sign a salon device out.
10. PIN = 6 digits (default) or 10 digits (e.g. own phone number). Owner picks in Settings → PIN rules (5.3). Tweak pinLen on 2.1–2.3 to preview.
11. Links: /desk (front desk) · /clock (time clock) · /kiosk (walk-ins) · /t (tech phone) · /me · /settings. New salon device = owner’s QR from Settings → Devices (5.4).

s1.text:
All 4 show the same jobs:
• Me: photo, name, phone, email, language, PIN, notifications, switch person
• Salon settings (owner/manager)
• Team: list + Add member with full details (role, language, pay type + rate, check/cash split, skills, license + expiry, workdays, invite text)

Click around: every option is clickable (Play).
Comment with “Look:” or “Use A + C’s panel” etc.
